name: S1-01 - Engraved Wayfinder
text:
[Slotless]

---

Effect To celebrate your success as a Pathfinder agent, Janira gave you a compass lid engraved with your name and a Glyph of the Open Road, symbol of the Pathfinder Society. You can attach this lid to any Compass, including a Wayfinder, to personalize it.
